function_signature: def classify_fault_pattern(correct_cipher: bytes, faulty_cipher: bytes) -> dict
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (15 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: the four diagonals must be derived from the definition of ShiftRows yourself
ciphertext values must not be hard-coded
the signature of a single-byte fault in the penultimate round is "forming a ShiftRows diagonal", not "lying in the same column"
4 bytes in the same column go to column/unknown
the returned fields must be complete with diff_bytes in ascending order
source: Piret-Quisquater CHES 2003; FIPS PUB 197, the definition of ShiftRows
author: Liang Jing
